task: Investigate duplicate notification delivery for job-7 using the supplied code and incident evidence. Separate the observed mechanism from unknown details and recommend a verifiable fix.

files.incident.log:
10:03:01 job=job-7 attempt=1 transport=accepted provider_id=p-100
10:03:02 job=job-7 attempt=1 mark_sent=timeout
10:03:05 job=job-7 attempt=2 sent=false
10:03:06 job=job-7 attempt=2 transport=accepted provider_id=p-101
10:03:07 job=job-7 attempt=2 mark_sent=success
files.contracts.md: The queue retries a failed job. In this incident the first mark_sent failed before persisting; store.sent returned false on retry. Transport acceptance means the provider accepted a send. The provider supports idempotency keys, but worker.py does not pass one. Provider delivery receipts and the underlying cause of the store timeout are unavailable.
